name: Folio
line: A little page with a lot of context.
idea: A folded cream page with a forest-green spine; it gathers knowledge and keeps your place.
motion: Unfolds, leans in to listen, then settles with a soft paper flutter.

name: Swift
idea: A sculptural paper swallow: quick, precise and quietly helpful across time zones.
motion: Glides on two folded wings, with a small attentive head tilt.

name: Sable
idea: An origami fox in forest green and warm cream, alert without looking mischievous.
motion: Its folded ears listen independently; the tail gives a restrained answering flick.

name: Nox
line: A calm pair of eyes after hours.
idea: A small ceramic owl with a wide cream facial disc and dark green wings.
motion: Slow blinks, tiny wing lifts and an observant side-to-side glance.

name: Loop
line: It connects the pieces for you.
idea: A continuous woven ribbon with a bright face in its open centre; a living connection.
motion: The two loops breathe and flex, with a point of light travelling through the weave.

name: Pip
line: A little context grows a long way.
idea: A warm ceramic seed with two folded green leaves, grounded and approachable.
motion: Leaves perk toward new information and relax when the work is done.

name: Cairn
idea: An asymmetric river pebble of glazed green stone with a cream face and gold seam.
motion: A weighted rocking settle, a small nod and a slowly orbiting thought pebble.

name: Luma
idea: A pocket lantern with folded paper wings and a warm living light inside.
motion: A gentle hovering pulse, delicate wingbeats and light that warms on an answer.

name: North
line: A sense of what matters next.
idea: A friendly brass-and-green pocket compass, its face floating within an open ring.
motion: Its needle finds direction and settles; the outer ring tips toward the next task.

name: Manta
idea: A folded-paper ray, broad cream wings over a green underside and a ribbon tail.
motion: A slow wave rolls through its fins as it glides between sources.

name: Tandem
idea: Two interlocking ceramic arcs, one green and one cream, form a single attentive face.
motion: The arcs counter-rotate gently and click back into alignment.

name: Post
idea: A soft-cornered envelope courier with a green fold, tiny satchel tab and amber seal.
motion: The flap perks up like a collar; it opens a little to offer a useful note.
